ideas.title: Black Obelisk of Shalmaneser III
ideas.note: Shows 'Jehu son of Omri' (or his envoy) bowing to the Assyrian king.

ideas.title: Shishak (Shoshenq I) relief at Karnak
ideas.note: List of towns in Israel and Judah taken in his campaign.

ideas.title: Jehoiachin ration tablets
ideas.note: Babylonian records of oil rations for 'Jehoiachin king of Judah'.

ideas.title: Babylonian Chronicle (597 BC)
ideas.note: Records Nebuchadnezzar taking 'the city of Judah' and appointing a new king.

ideas.title: Erastus inscription (Corinth)
ideas.note: Pavement naming an Erastus as aedile; identification debated.
